team.name: Marcel Kempers
team.focus: Partnerships, funding and project leadership across reefs, mangroves and coastal monitoring.
team.bio: Marcel co-founded Reef Support in 2020 and leads its partnerships, funding strategy and consortium projects, from the Coral Lab in Lombok to coastal monitoring work in the Netherlands and Colombia. He holds an MSc in Management of Technology from TU Delft (finance and technology specialisation, thesis graded 10/10) and a BSc in Aerospace Engineering from TU Delft, with study at Politecnico di Milano, Tokyo Institute of Technology and Tsinghua University. He is also a research assistant on financing systems at TU Delft's Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management. Recognition includes the ESA Copernicus Masters Overall Prize (2020, with Reef Support), Falling Walls Lab Groningen first prize (2021), MT/Sprout 25 under 25 and FD 50 Young Talents (2021), the Hult Prize Tokyo (2019) and Falling Walls Emerging Talent (2023).

team.name: Yohan Runhaar
team.focus: AI models, data engineering and software for marine monitoring.
team.bio: Yohan co-founded Reef Support and leads its technology, from the coral segmentation models published on Hugging Face to the data pipelines and field data tools used in partner projects. His research on coral classification and segmentation, carried out with University of Amsterdam support, produced "Superpixels to the Rescue" (2022). He holds an MSc in Artificial Intelligence [TO CONFIRM: institution and year] and studied computer science at TU Delft. He was named to MT/Sprout 25 under 25 in 2021.

team.name: Nikole Gualdron Chaparro
team.focus: Monitoring design, ecological indicators and scientific review.
team.bio: Nikole is Reef Support's Director of Marine Science. She sets the scientific basis for the indicators and monitoring designs Reef Support proposes and reviews every marine science claim before it is published or submitted.
